card.name: Space before a dose amount
card.fires_on: The space (or small joining word) right after an antibody drug name or a duration, just before a number such as a dose or count of doses. Seen in checkpoint-inhibitor dosing lines such as nivolumab, ipilimumab and pembrolizumab.

modes.label: After drug name
modes.description: Space after a combination partner drug name, just before its mg/kg dose.
modes.example: YERVOY 3 mg/kg immediately following nivolumab<< >>1 mg/kg on the same day,

modes.label: After "for"
modes.description: Space after "for" before a number of weeks or doses.
modes.example: Administer KEYTRUDA QLEX 395 mg/4,800 units every 3 weeks for<< >>4 doses or 790 mg

modes.label: Between antibody names
modes.description: Linking word between two antibody drug names.

card.writes: It pushes down the chance of antibody or response words coming next, since a number should follow.
card.plain: It marks the gap just before a dose number in antibody cancer drug regimens.
